title: Bound for the final-block term
statement: For all nonnegative integers $w$ and $i$, define $a_i=((2^i-1)(4/9)^i)/i!$ and $r_i=(4/9)^i/i!$. Then $\binom{w}{i}2^i\leq (9w/4)^i(a_i+r_i)$.
